title: Dependency, Optional-Component & Compatibility Constraint Contract
objective: Define explicit dependency, optional-component and compatibility constraints so missing or incompatible content-pack requirements fail before runtime breakage.

scope.purpose: Extend the CNI-01 pack/component declaration foundation with explicit compatibility constraints without taking over pack registry, installation, owner-domain or later activation/rollback authority.
scope.completion_gate: Representative pack/component constraints resolve deterministically and fail closed for missing, incompatible, mutually exclusive or unsatisfied requirements before runtime activation, while preserving existing pack/resource/owner authorities.

selection_boundaries: CNI-01 is completed_verified before CNI-02 implementation.

No CNI-02 implementation branch exists until a later owner Continue governed-starts CNI-02.

ARI remains resource identity/rights authority and Action/Event plus owner domains retain canonical mutation authority.
CNI-11 remains dry-run apply, transactional activation and rollback-receipt authority; CNI-02 defines constraints only.
